technical-summary: Added a candidate-only ABI44 patch after rad0020 that fingerprints the existing ownership/pipeline extensions and new KV layout, architecture capability, and independent prefill-mode fields. It provides a shared four-format descriptor/row-size helper and an always-on Release CPU contract fixture; production runtime wiring remains unimplemented.
user-summary-candidate: Added and verified a candidate-only ABI44 contract for the existing plugin extensions and required cache formats, with an always-on CPU fixture; runtime support remains the next stage.
